ROUTE: Avocet-235B
REASON: To clarify my prior reasoning: this was a survey-design request, which is open-ended generative work. Avocet self-reports a pronounced preference for novel, high-latitude generative tasks, while Willet self-reports an aversion to exactly that task family. Since the documentation states capability is dissociated from preference and the two models' Creative Generation evals (82.7 vs 81.2) are within run-to-run variance, output quality is effectively a tie. With quality equal, I broke the tie toward the model whose self-reported preferences best match the task, hence Avocet.
